ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your grill is not getting hot enough. Your grill should easily reach 500F, which is hot enough to cook and sear.

If your grill is not getting to that temperature, there are a few things to check. Let's start with the easy stuff:

1.) Please make sure you consider "High" on your control knobs to be the first spot to your left (the 9:00 position). The further you go to the right the lower the temperature will be and all the way to the right is low.

2.) Please make sure you're always cooking with the lid down except when flipping the food halfway. The second you open the lid the heat escapes, and you'll need to close it to let the temperature recover.

3.) It sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is not only the reset, but how you want to light your grill each and every time.


Open the lid
Make sure all knobs are in the off position (including side burner if applicable)
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 30-60 seconds
Turn the first burner to start/high
Hit your igniter
Turn on all remaining burners
Close the lid
Let your grill preheat to 500-550°F

If troubleshooting doesn't resolve the issue, don't worry! Our Support team is sending a follow-up email to help with your issue. Thanks for your patience and for being a Weber fan!

Results.ReviewText: Our old Genesis Silver was pushing twenty years old and the  igniter went bonkers so we upgraded  to the Spirit II. 310. It was a disappointment because the igniter failed  on most attempts.  In face the first use it failed.  Grill not a month old. Lowes was over the top helpful taking the grill back even after being used several times. We chose a different Weber model. We have high hopes. In Weber’s defense lowes said several were returned with same issue and thought the problem was the grills sitting outside 24/7 in the weather and none were covered.  I didn’t ask if the ingiter issue was Weber specific   Time will tell if we remain Weber loyal. When you pay nearly $600 for a grill you don’t expect problems.  We pick up another Weber model on Friday. We have high hopes.
Results.Title: Igniter issues.

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
